newsitem.title: USA: Fortress sees 1997 EPS at about $0.80/shr.
newsitem.headline: Fortress sees 1997 EPS at about $0.80/shr.

text.p: Fortress Group, reporting a dropping net income for the quarter ended June 30, said Friday it expected to earn about $0.80 a share from existing operations in the current calendar year.

This compares with pro-forma earnings per share of $0.88 in 1996, after deducting $0.12 a share for adjustsments that would have been attributable to pro-forma interest savings from a lower cost of capital as a result of its initial public offering, the home manufacturer said.
A May 6 First Call poll of two analysts had put the company's earnings at $1.14 for 1997.
Fortress Friday reported a net income of $1.3 million, or $0.10 a share, ifor the second quarter ended June 30, compared with a $1.9 million net, or $0.19 a share, in the 1996 quarter.

The company's quarterly operating income, excluding two non-recurring charges, rose to $3 million, or $0.14 a share, from a $2.9 million operating income in the 1996 quarter. The First Call poll had expected the company to earn $0.26 a share in the 1997 second quarter.
